title: A PR that changes install.sh or its test runs both install CI jobs
why: Coordinator 16:27 CST Nov 9: #2458 changed install.sh (+35) and hooks/test_install_src.sh (+144), but its own PR run skipped checks-merge-install and shell-macos, so the batch found the step-cap overrun, not the lane. Harm: a lane's cost lands on the whole batch (#2470 is held for lane shoot-job-cap).
note: Fix: the CI job scope (lint/test_ci_scope.py and the workflow's path rules) runs checks-merge-install and shell-macos when a PR changes install.sh or hooks/test_install_src.sh. Done check: a scope test case with that file set selects both jobs, red on main. Related: ci-scope-playwright-action (done, same shape), shoot-job-cap. Lane session_013NEJL456ejBKaXgyyLuYHS started 16:28 CST Nov 9 (coordinator). Closed, not a defect (coordinator 16:29 CST Nov 9): #2458 was a draft, and drafts skip every CI job by design (decision draft-until-reviewed). On main, ci-scope.sh already selects both install jobs for that file set (checked by the lane). The real gap moved to step ci-guard-headroom.
